title: Rexue Zuqiu Shaonian: Yingxiong Chusheng

alternative_titles.ja: 热血足球少年·英雄初升

synopsis:
Wang Cheng, a prodigy soccer player, is the core of the club's attack. Amidst the praise, he becomes arrogant, leading to a loss in a crucial match. Frustrated, he and his friend Ze Yang accept the challenge from the mysterious Uncle Ai's robot team. During the match, he finally understands the value of teamwork and ultimately returns to the team to win the victory.

(Source: Douban, translated)
